common.strength_application: once per Attack card; first resolved hit against main target
common.agility_application: once per Defend card; first immediate Block grant
common.upgrades: one per instance, explicit row; never blanket Passive energy discount

cards.name: Rune Strike
cards.normal: 6 damage
cards.reason: Anchor Attack 1 Energy.

cards.name: Weak Point
cards.normal: 4 damage; kemudian Vulnerable 1
cards.reason: Focus lebih kecil kerana status memberi nilai tambahan.

cards.name: Scout Strike
cards.normal: 4 damage; draw 1
cards.reason: Draw menampung pengurangan damage asas/Focus.

cards.name: Return Strike
cards.normal: 5 damage; +3 jika hilang HP pada enemy turn terakhir
cards.reason: Bonus bersyarat diperiksa sekali sebelum kesan.

cards.name: Sure Hit
cards.normal: 5 damage; abaikan Block
cards.reason: Defense dan Boss Seal masih berkuat kuasa.

cards.name: Twin Shot
cards.normal: 3 + 3 damage
cards.reason: Strength sekali bagi kad; setiap hit masih melalui Defense.

cards.name: Shield Shot
cards.normal: 5 damage; +3 jika mempunyai Block sebelum bermain
cards.reason: Block tidak digunakan; manfaat perlu setup.

cards.name: Crack Shot
cards.normal: Buang sehingga 4 Block musuh; kemudian 5 damage
cards.reason: Nilai bergantung pada armor Block musuh.

cards.name: Rune Sweep
cards.normal: 12 damage kepada setiap musuh hidup
cards.focused: 16 kepada sasaran utama; 12 kepada yang lain
cards.reason: Naik daripada 6: encounter semasa satu musuh. Multi-enemy memerlukan retune sebelum diaktifkan.

cards.name: Fate Storm
cards.normal: 3 hit rawak, setiap hit 5 damage
cards.reason: Naik jumlah 9 ke 15; Strength/Focus hanya pada hit pertama.

cards.name: Rune Guard
cards.normal: 6 Block
cards.reason: Anchor Defend 1 Energy.

cards.name: Flash Ward
cards.normal: 3 Block; Exhaust
cards.reason: Hadkan Focus dan upgrade pada kad percuma.

cards.name: Tower Shield
cards.normal: 14 Block
cards.reason: Focus +5 memberi nilai kepada komitmen 2 Energy.

cards.name: Ember Wall
cards.normal: 5 Block; Thorns 2 hingga enemy phase seterusnya tamat
cards.reason: Turun Block 6 ke 5 untuk membayar nilai damage balasan.

cards.name: Foreseen Guard
cards.normal: 4 Block; +4 jika intent mengandungi Attack
cards.reason: Musuh mempunyai guard-only turn supaya syarat bukan sentiasa benar.

cards.name: Layered Shield
cards.normal: 4 Block sekarang; 3 Block pada awal giliran sendiri berikutnya
cards.reason: Agility hanya pada pemberian pertama; nilai tertunda fixed.

cards.name: Burning Pages
cards.normal: 4 Block; draw 1
cards.reason: Focus +2 kerana draw sudah menambah nilai.

cards.name: Cinder Guard
cards.normal: 5 Block; Weak 1 pada musuh
cards.reason: Weak bernilai sehingga 2 damage yang dielakkan pada satu hit.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.normal: 12 Block; simpan sehingga 5 baki Block sekali
cards.reason: Naik segera 10 ke 12; simpanan bukan Block baharu.

cards.name: Mana Barrier
cards.normal: 7X Block; gunakan semua baki Energy positif
cards.upgrade: Tambah 2 Block flat selepas 7X; tidak mengubah gandaan.
cards.reason: Fleksibel dan berguna pada X=1/2/3; X dikunci ketika commit.

cards.name: Quick Study
cards.normal: Draw 2
cards.reason: Draw biasa yang boleh diulang.

cards.name: Deep Study
cards.normal: Draw 3; Exhaust
cards.reason: Ubah 2 Energy/draw 4 kepada pilihan 1 Energy sekali setiap combat.

cards.name: Mana Reading
cards.normal: Draw 2 sekarang; +1 draw giliran berikutnya; Exhaust
cards.upgrade: Draw tertunda +1; Focus hanya draw segera.
cards.reason: Ganti X/all-Energy yang meninggalkan tiada Energy untuk menggunakan hasil draw.

cards.name: Read Ahead
cards.normal: Lihat sehingga 3; ambil 1; susun baki di atas Draw
cards.upgrade: Had lihat asas +1; bonus Focus kekal +2.
cards.reason: Focus menambah dua pilihan, tanpa draw tambahan.

cards.name: Burning Page
cards.normal: Lihat calon; boleh ganti 1 kali; ambil 1; Exhaust
cards.focused: Boleh ganti sehingga 3 kali; ambil 1; Exhaust
cards.reason: Kurangkan kos 1 ke 0; Exhaust mencegah kitaran percuma.

cards.name: Clear Choice
cards.normal: Lihat sehingga 4; ambil 1; buang baki ke Discard
cards.reason: Nilai berbeza daripada Read Ahead melalui discard calon.

cards.name: Card Search
cards.normal: Pilih kategori; cari padanan pertama dalam sehingga 5 kad
cards.reason: Carian sah boleh gagal; tidak menukar kepada jaminan.

cards.name: Recall
cards.normal: Ambil semula 1 kad Discard pilihan; Exhaust
cards.upgrade: Tambah draw 1 kepada versi biasa; Focus tambah 1 lagi.
cards.reason: Tidak boleh memilih dirinya; tidak mengulang had trigger Passive.

cards.name: Next Chapter
cards.normal: +2 draw pada giliran sendiri berikutnya
cards.reason: Focus +2 membayar kelewatan; grant sekali sahaja.

cards.name: Last Page
cards.normal: Draw 1; draw tambahan 2 jika tangan kosong selepas kad keluar
cards.reason: Snapshot tangan sekali sebelum semua draw dan pencetus.

cards.name: Blazing Spirit
cards.normal: +2 Strength selama aktif dalam combat
cards.reason: Strength kini sekali per kad; kos tidak dikurangkan menjadi percuma.

cards.name: Growing Flame
cards.normal: Selepas setiap 3 Attack selepas aktif: +1 Strength, maksimum +3
cards.upgrade: Kira setiap 2 Attack; maksimum sumbangan +3 kekal.
cards.reason: Kurangkan setup 2 ke 1 Energy; kira kad, bukan hit.

cards.name: Swift Step
cards.normal: +2 Agility selama aktif dalam combat
cards.reason: Agility sekali pada pemberian segera pertama setiap kad Defend.

cards.name: Battle Rhythm
cards.normal: Selepas setiap 3 Defend selepas aktif: +1 Agility, maksimum +3
cards.upgrade: Kira setiap 2 Defend; had sumbangan +3 kekal.
cards.reason: Kurangkan setup 2 ke 1 Energy.

cards.name: Rune Armor
cards.normal: +1 Defense selama aktif dalam combat
cards.upgrade: Tambahan 3 Block sekali pada pengaktifan pertama combat.
cards.reason: Kurangkan kos 2 ke 1; upgrade tidak menggandakan Defense.

cards.name: Lasting Shield
cards.normal: Simpan sehingga 4 baki Block setiap awal giliran
cards.reason: Dengan Hold the Line gunakan maksimum, bukan jumlah.

cards.name: Grimoire Ward
cards.normal: Skill pertama selepas aktif setiap giliran: +3 Block fixed
cards.reason: Maksimum sekali/giliran; tiada Agility.

cards.name: Ember Core
cards.normal: Selepas kad benar-benar guna Focus: 3 fixed HP damage
cards.reason: Naik 2 ke 3; maksimum sekali/giliran, tiada recursion.

cards.name: Clear Mind
cards.normal: +1 draw setiap awal giliran bermula giliran berikutnya
cards.upgrade: Draw 1 sekali pada pengaktifan pertama combat.
cards.reason: Kurangkan setup 2 ke 1 Energy; tiada pencetus segera berulang ketika swap.

cards.name: Last Ember
cards.normal: Ketika hidup dan HP <=30%: +6 Block, +1 Focus, sekali/combat
cards.upgrade: Block pencetus +2; threshold dan Focus kekal.
cards.reason: Trigger tidak reset selepas swap/Recall; tidak revive.

validation.target_unit: one student, one first scored complete two-stage Challenge run after standard tutorial
validation.target_denominator: all eligible started runs; defeat/voluntary abandon count as losses; verified technical failures reported separately

status_rules.stat_application: Strength and Agility once per eligible played card; no stat on fixed/delayed grants unless explicitly specified
